title: Cuban-Style Black Beans and Rice with Coconut Cream
description: Hearty black beans simmered with spices and vegetables, served over rice with fresh tomatoes, herbs, and a drizzle of coconut cream.

steps.instruction: Cook the rice according to package instructions and set aside.
Gently warm the coconut cream until smooth and pourable, then set aside.
In a bowl, toss tomatoes and herbs with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Let marinate.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion, bell pepper, and cumin, and cook until soft and golden, about 10–15 minutes.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Stir in the black beans and stock, then simmer gently.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve rice topped with beans, marinated tomatoes, avocado, herbs, and a drizzle of coconut cream. Add lime wedges on the side.
